reaction: Seeing the store shrink made the route clear; the easing signal was a useful detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following insulin to the muscle store was most worthwhile: it showed glucose becoming stored material while insulin remained a message outside the cells.

leastWorthwhile.text: The lower-glucose route was clear but less engaging as a choice: its two combinations were the only ones offered at those points.

surprise.text: The liver-release signal eases as blood glucose rises, adding a feedback detail to the storage-and-release story.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, but the second hormone was described by its job rather than named. I followed the labelled pairing without knowing its name.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the contrast between muscle storage and liver release made the body’s changing fuel needs understandable, though I’d hope for more meaningful choices.
